history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

rs-additive-existing.description: Existing shopping + legacy returns; corrected additive-return build; shopping, combat and inherited depth rules do not depend on the return switch.

4.2.6-rs-pr92-home-fix.label: M13 Rust Borg at borg-rs main 8c5d000a, PR92's merge (borg-zoo#129): PR88's added town-return triggers (7251f64a, an ancestor) plus PR92, which stops a confirmed Home transfer being reversed within the same visit (the borg-rs#90 oil store/take loop). Same flags as 4.2.6-rs-pr88-additive-returns, plus the zoo's frozen-turn and key-outlier checks.

classes-1800-d.description: Fresh PR85 return-threshold development: 1800 starts, 200 per class, all eleven races cycled; 100000 world-turn after-key cap. Appended seed rule; existing suites unchanged.

experiment.description: PR92's Home fix with PR88's return-only trip policy (borg-zoo#129): the six rs-additive-returns arms on borg-rs 8c5d000a. Same frozen 1800 starts per choice, 10800 games total.

full.name: rs-home-fix-returns
full.owner_authorization: 2026-11-16 owner request (borg-zoo#129, from borg-rs): test merged PR92's Home fix with PR88's return-only trip policy in a fresh pinned study, reusing the rs-additive-returns design and exact shopping settings; a small configuration/native pilot first. 2026-11-16 the owner asked for a control run in the meantime. Runner rule: bounded shards, at most 20 game jobs and one game process per job.
full.prespecified: Development rerun on the same frozen classes-1800-d starts and 100000-world-turn after-key cap as rs-additive-returns, not fresh-seed confirmation. Primary: paired natural deaths against rs-additive-shopping-only (live inventory planner on, added trip policy off). Report every attempted failure and incomplete cell first. Secondary: per-class outcomes, final character level and deepest level, town time, actual town arrivals, added return-goal transitions, native purchases and inventory disposition. Home-loop diagnostics: Home store/take traffic from retained native receipts, the busiest game turn per cell (a cell with 1,000+ keys at one game turn is recorded as stalled, kind frozen_turn_loop, observed outcome kept) and key outliers (more than 3 times the arm's median keys over its turn-cap cells, flagged and listed; endpoints reported with and without them). Compare (1,4) vs (2,4) for pack slack and (1,2) vs (1,4) for the learning threshold. Returns and reduced unknown counts are not proof of completed identification. No mid-run retuning; no promotion or improvement claim without a separately agreed confirmation. Cross-build comparison with rs-additive-returns (same starts, PR92 absent) is descriptive only. Inspect the 54-cell native smoke before dispatching any arm on classes-1800-d.
full.source_notes: All arms pin borg-rs main 8c5d000a58e9ddca1f1954ab9552e505856b313f, PR92's merge, which contains PR88 (7251f64a). The six profiles are the rs-additive-returns profiles, unchanged, so every resolved setting equals that study's; only the source differs (PR92 added). New specimen and experiment; rs-additive-returns, PR85, PR88 and reborn pins and results are preserved. (0,0) is full-pack returns with learning-driven returns disabled, not policy off. The trip switch does not change shopping forecasts, inventory valuation or combat oil reserves.
